latest_release.body:
# Posterizarr 4.0.3 **Feature & stability release bringing Dry-Run preview galleries, new Dynamic Overlay builders and customization controls, paginated Jellyfin/Emby library scans, and Jellyfin plugin fixes.**

☕ Support on Ko-fi · 💬 Discord · 🎨 Community Gallery Repo · ⚡ 5-Minute Quickstart · Documentation · Dynamic Overlays Guide · Web UI Guide

Posterizarr 4.0.3 expands Dynamic Overlays with Dry-Run artwork previews, external list/ribbon/stinger builders, per-state Series Status and resolution tier controls, while fixing large Jellyfin/Emby library timeouts, Jellyfin plugin HTTPS/manifest issues, and Manual/Arr mode edge cases. > ☕ **Enjoying Posterizarr?** Posterizarr is free and open source. If it makes your library look great, consider **[supporting Posterizarr on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/R6R81S6SC)**, starring the repo, or sharing your own presets in **[posterizarr-community](https://github.com/fscorrupt/posterizarr-community)**! --- ## Dynamic Overlays & Visual Studio - **Dry-Run Preview Gallery:** Preview rendered Dry-Run artwork directly inside the WebUI without pushing changes to your media server. - **External Builders, Ribbons & Media Stingers:** Added cached IMDb charts/awards, MDBList membership, TMDb keyword rules, award/chart ribbons, and movie media stingers (#706). - **Resolution Tiers & Per-State Series Status:** Configure which resolution/HDR/Dolby Vision tiers render, customize Series Status toggles/labels/colors per state, and fixed banner vs. corner-badge detection (#711, #706). - **Languages, Regional Flags & Style-Scoped Assets:** Uncapped language flag limits, bundled regional flag fallbacks, collision-free style-scoped asset paths, and improved show/season stream aggregation (#711). - **Kometa Bundle Dependencies & Global Search:** Optional automatic fetch/validation of missing official Kometa assets on bundle import, improved custom font discovery (#706), tighter `config.yml` sync, and Global Search indexing + jump-to-setting for Dynamic Overlay engine/provider settings. ## Jellyfin / Emby & Plugin Fixes - **Paginated Library Scans:** Overlay Sync and Change Detection now query Jellyfin/Emby `/Items` in 500-item pages (dropping unused `Overview`) with higher timeouts and clear error logging — resolving timeout failures on large libraries. - **Jellyfin/Emby Plugin Fixes:** Fixed Real-Time Sync WebSocket URLs behind HTTPS/reverse proxies, added local/self-signed certificate support, and normalized 4-part Jellyfin manifest versions (`Repository: Unknown`, missing logo, and disable/uninstall issues). - **Manual, Arr & Season Fixes:** Manual Mode now bypasses EXIF skips (`-SkipExifCheck`) on Jellyfin/Emby uploads, Arr Mode populates episode title-card URLs, parallel `SkipTBA`/`SkipJapTitle` counters are thread-safe, and single/localized/missing season metadata is handled cleanly (#710). ## WebUI, Security & Automation - **Onboarding & Action Center:** Added poster-style presets to Onboarding, stale-media cleanup in Action Center, and live disk/CSV refresh for Recent Assets. - **Security & Release Tooling:** Hardened preview file lookup and API error responses (CodeQL clean), documented webhook API key headers, and added a custom formatted Discord release webhook. --- ## What's Changed * Sync

detail.readme:
Automated Artwork & Native Dynamic Overlays for Plex, Jellyfin & Emby

Generate consistent posters, seasons, backgrounds, title cards, and collections — while keeping your clean source artwork untouched on disk.

       

Documentation »  ·  Installation  ·  Dynamic Overlays  ·  Artwork Showcase  ·  Community Gallery



🎨 Automated Artwork
Generate matching posters, seasons, title cards, backgrounds, collections, and clearlogos via TMDb, TheTVDB, Fanart.tv, and Plex. 		✨ Native Dynamic Overlays
Import Kometa-style YAML, preview badges live, share portable bundles via the Community Gallery, and composite in memory — no extra container, clean sources untouched.
📺 Plex, Jellyfin & Emby
Direct sync, real-time WebSocket plugins with optional Plex Direct Sync, AniMetaFill, Asset Title Review, local IMDb ratings, and Plex Image Cleanup. (Silo: experimental) 		⚡ Web UI & Automation
All-in-one Web UI with guided setup, built-in Scheduler, native Tautulli, Sonarr, and Radarr webhooks, Testing Mode, and safe Dry Run.

🚀 Get Started

Docker Compose, Unraid, PowerShell guides, Web UI walkthroughs, and API references live on the dedicated docs site.
